sn54.1:1.1: tatravagguddānaṃ: gaṅgāpeyyāloppamādo balakaraṇīyesanā oghoti pañceva vaggā jhānasaṃyuttā siyunti. 10. ānāpānasaṃyuttaṃ 1. ekadhammavaggo 10. 1. 1. ekadhammasuttaṃ sāvatthinidānaṃ.
sn54.1:1.3: ekadhammo bhikkhave, bhāvito bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
sn54.1:1.6: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave, ānāpānasati kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti, mahānisaṃsā:
sn54.1:1.7: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
